package.description: Official CLI for the InternetData API

en-US.description: Official CLI for the InternetData API
en-US.longDescription:
Look up what an IP address is - where it is, the AS and company behind it,
and whether it is a VPN, a proxy, a Tor exit, a relay, or a hosting, CDN,
carrier or satellite network - one address at a time or in bulk, look up an AS
or a domain, and download the databases.

Works with no account: Unlimited, the free plan, answers where an address is,
its AS and company, and whether it is a Tor exit or a relay, with no cap.
en-US.name: InternetData CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
Breaking changes
- whoami: the plan behind the key and what it has used (0de94bf)
Features
- Take sdk-go v2.10.0: talk to api.internetdata.io, sign in at the apex (2dcc2a1)
- Look up an address, an AS or a domain, one or millions, and your own (14427b2)
